'''Sikurdians''' were short, round bipeds native to [[Sikurd]] who invented the [[Sikurdian battle-axe]].

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Sikurdian pirates entered an alliance with [[Tervig]] and [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] slavers establishing illegal trade routes along the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]]. The slaver union also began raiding the newly reorganized [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], an independent territory that shared borders with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

A notorious Sikurdian was [[Alabar Double Ax]].
